_notes: Only keys you want to change need to be here; everything else uses the defaults in 07_Bay_Occupancy.py. min_box_area_frac: smallest truck box (as a fraction of the whole frame) that counts as a truck in the bay. occupied_confirm_count/empty_confirm_count: consecutive rounds that must agree before the state flips (empty is higher so a missed detection can't flap the bay). MQTT publishes only on a confirmed change, retained, to <topic_prefix>/<bay>.
